subject_uz: Muborak neft-gaz konlarida quduq geologik-texnologik tadqiqotlari: qatlam bosimi va haroratini o'lchash, GDI/GKI, PLT

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma summasining 15 foizi avans sifatida shartnoma ro'yxatdan o'tgach 15 kalendar kun ichida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 15 percent of the contract value is paid as an advance within 15 calendar days after registration.
requirements.quote: kalendar kun ichida shartnoma summasining 15% miqdorida avans

requirements.summary_uz: Qolgan 85 foiz oylik hisob-faktura va qabul qilish dalolatnomasi asosida 90 kalendar kun ichida to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The remaining 85 percent is paid within 90 calendar days against monthly invoices and acceptance acts.
requirements.quote: hamda qabul qilish dalolatnomasiga asosan buyurtmachi tomonidan qabul qilingan hamda kreditorlik

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif narxi boshlang'ich narxdan (QQS bilan 1 507 029 773 so'm) oshmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bid price must not exceed the start price (1,507,029,773 UZS including VAT).
requirements.quote: Tanlov taklifida ko'rsatilgan narxlar boshlang'ich narxdan oshmasligi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif ta'minoti (depozit yoki bank kafolati) talab qilinmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: No bid security (deposit or bank guarantee) is required.
requirements.quote: Tanlov taklifini ta'minlash uchun kafolat miqdori (depozit yoki bank kafolati): Talab qilinmaydi.

requirements.summary_uz: Takliflarni topshirishning oxirgi muddati 5 ish kuni deb ko'rsatilgan.
requirements.summary_en: The deadline for submitting bids is stated as 5 working days.
requirements.quote: Takliflarni topshirishning oxirgi muddati 5 ish kuni

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif topshirilgan kundan kamida 90 kun amal qilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bid must stay valid for at least 90 days from submission.
requirements.quote: takliflar topshirilgan kundan boshlab kamida 90 kun.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi soliq organidan soliq qarzi yo'qligi haqida ma'lumotnoma taqdim etishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: A tax-authority certificate confirming no tax debt must be provided.
requirements.quote: soliq organlaridan olingan, soliq qarzdorligi mavjud emasligini tasdiqlovchi

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat xatida ishtirokchi mijoz bilan sud yoki arbitraj jarayonida emasligini tasdiqlaydi.
requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter must confirm the bidder is not in court or arbitration proceedings with the customer.
requirements.quote: ishtirokchi mijoz bilan sud yoki arbitraj jarayoni holatida emas

requirements.summary_uz: Moliyaviy holat (4-shakl) bilan birga moliyaviy hisobotlar nusxasi ilova qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Copies of financial statements must accompany the financial position form (form 4).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchilar moliyaviy natijalar to'g'risidagi hisobotlarning (balanslarning) nusxalarini

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik taklif bilan taklif etilayotgan xizmat xususiyatlarining qiyosiy jadvali taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: The technical proposal must include a comparison table of the offered specifications.
requirements.quote: varaqlarda taklif qilingan mahsulotlarning texnik xususiyatlarining qiyosiy jadvali

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik baholashdan o'tmagan takliflar chetlashtiriladi; texnik taklif 60 ballgacha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Bids failing the technical evaluation are excluded; the technical proposal is scored up to 60 points.
requirements.quote: Takliflari texnik baholashdan o'tmagan ishtirokchilar tanlov jarayonidan chetlashtiriladi.

documents_needed_uz: Tashkilotning davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganligi to'g'risidagi guvohnoma
Kafolat xati: qayta tashkil etish, tugatish, sud yoki arbitraj jarayoni, muddati o'tgan qarz va sanksiyalar ro'yxati bo'yicha (2-shakl)
Tanlov ishtirokchisi haqida umumiy ma'lumot, ta'sischilar va foydali egalar (3-shakl)
Yetkazib berish (xizmat ko'rsatish) tajribasi to'g'risida ma'lumot
Moliyaviy holat to'g'risida ma'lumot va moliyaviy hisobotlar nusxasi (4-shakl)
Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha qarzi yo'qligi haqida soliq organi ma'lumotnomasi
Kontragent va sanksiyalar so'rovnomasi hamda tegishli hujjatlar (6-shakl)
Texnik taklif va xususiyatlarning qiyosiy jadvali (7-shakl)
Kafolat muddati va kafolat hajmi bo'yicha kafolat xati
